title: release(next): 18.0.0-next.2 shipped 11 changesets with no CHANGELOG entry (the version PR merged behind main; #21361's class, in pre mode)
body:
Filing gate: **(b) a defect measured at a public door.** Found by the os-dev on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2124 (the hotcrm bump to 18.0.0-next.2, report on that card). Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (seat post #6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`); the seat re-read the evidence below. ⛔ Not a claim.
Dedupe: #21361 is the same class: a Version Packages PR that merges behind `main` ships changesets with no CHANGELOG entry. It was closed by PR #21373 (`7b21af80cb`, `release.yml` plus `scripts/release-pending-publish.mjs`), and on this cut the guard did not hold. #23282, #23703, #22586 and #23136 are other release-text cards and not this one. #23801 is next.2's Docker failure, a different step.

## What is wrong

`chore: version packages (next)` (#23481, release commit `e5136ff10f`) was generated from base `4fe8b3def0` and merged at 2026-10-16T02:44Z. Eleven changesets that landed on `main` in between ship in the 18.0.0-next.2 packages, but no 18.0.0-next.2 `CHANGELOG.md` entry names them. They are still unconsumed at the root of `.changeset/` at `e5136ff10f` (`git ls-tree e5136ff10f .changeset/`):

`23528-exposure-refusal-code`, `23609-legacy-org-read-seam`, `23610-page-isdefault-template-slots`, `23634-stack-datasource-default-refused`, `23712-draft-save-d99-address`, `23714-unique-violation-arm-relay`, `23723-sandbox-unreadable-rejection`, `23732-attachment-readable-ids`, `23735-reference-deleted-when`, `23740-form-section-columns-no-default`, `console-daeb77fc84dd`.

Each one's commit is an ancestor of `e5136ff10f`. For example, `a69a40a572` (objectstack#23610, committed 02:00Z) is.

## Reach (public door)

The published `@objectstack/spec@18.0.0-next.2` refuses page template `full-width`, a region its template does not place, and `isDefault` off a record page (objectstack#23610). On hotcrm, `os validate` exits 1 on the bump alone: `pages.0.template: Page template full-width was removed in @objectstack/spec 18`. Yet `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md`'s 18.0.0-next.2 section at `e5136ff10f` has 0 lines naming `full-width`.

The v18 release page tells consumers: "Those changesets become the CHANGELOG.md entries shipped inside each 18.0.0-next.N package, so read the CHANGELOG of every prerelease you move to". A consumer who follows it does not learn about this breaking change, nor about `23634` (a stack datasource default is refused).

Left as is, the 11 entries will appear under the next prerelease's heading, which mis-dates when they shipped.

## Done when

- The 18.0.0-next.2 release text covers the 11 changesets: corrected in place, or carried by the next cut under a heading that says they shipped in next.2. Which of the two is the release owner's call.
- The release path refuses, or refreshes, a Version Packages PR whose base is behind `main` by a changeset in pre mode, the case #21373's guard did not catch. Measured with a reproduction.
